前面加了 20 多毫升几乎看不出变化，为什么最后半滴颜色就全变了？: After adding more than 20 mL with hardly any change, why does the last half drop change the color completely?
半滴就让 pH 跳约 5 个单位: Half a drop makes the pH jump about 5 units
变色范围落在突跃里，颜色变了就是终点: Its color-change range lies inside the jump; when the color changes, that is the endpoint
润洗、赶气泡、平视，c 才不偏: Rinse, clear bubbles, read at eye level, and c will not drift
三个实验站 + 一个放大模型: Three lab stations + one magnified model
整体 · 一张实验台上做完一次滴定，旁边放大到离子: Overview · a full titration on one bench, magnified down to the ions alongside
滴一滴、看颜色、读刻度，三个读数一起动: Add a drop, watch the color, read the scale: all three readings move together
全对！计量关系、突跃、指示剂和误差方向你都理顺了。: All correct! You have sorted out stoichiometry, the jump, the indicator and the direction of errors.
建议回看主线：先看半滴为什么能让 pH 突变，再看四个错误操作各把 c 推到哪一: Review the main thread: first see why half a drop can make the pH jump, then see which way each of the four mistakes pushes c.
滴定管读数 0.01 mL · 看凹液面: Burette reading 0.01 mL · read the meniscus
H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O · 正在看锥形瓶: H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O · viewing the flask
铁架台夹住 50 mL 酸式滴定管，装 0.1000 mol/L HCl；0 刻: A stand holds a 50 mL acid burette filled with 0.1000 mol/L HCl; the 0 mark is at the top and it reads to 0.01 mL
250 mL 锥形瓶盛 20.00 mL 待测 NaOH，瓶下垫白纸，加 2 滴: A 250 mL conical flask holds 20.00 mL of NaOH sample on white paper, with 2 drops of indicator whose color follows the pH
碱式滴定管量取 20.00 mL 待测液；烧杯接润洗废液，洗瓶冲内壁: A base burette measures out 20.00 mL of sample; a beaker catches rinse waste and a wash bottle rinses the walls
锥形瓶里那一层：H⁺ 与 OH⁻ 结合成水（示意放大，正在看锥形瓶）: One layer inside the flask: H⁺ and OH⁻ combine into water (magnified for illustration, viewing the flask)
教材给了这些玻璃器皿，一滴盐酸从哪进去、终点又靠什么看？: The textbook gives us this glassware. Where does a drop of HCl go in, and what tells us the endpoint?
三站都在：铁架台上的滴定管（有刻度与凹液面）、垫着白纸的锥形瓶、量取用的碱式滴定: All three stations are here: the burette on the stand (with scale and meniscus), the flask on white paper, and the base burette and wash bottle for measuring; above the bench is the magnified ion box. Main reading pH 13.02, burette final reading 0.00 mL
0.1000 mol/L HCl · 20.00 mL 待测 NaOH · 2: 0.1000 mol/L HCl · 20.00 mL NaOH sample · 2 drops of indicator
两支滴定管分工：酸式装 HCl（玻璃活塞），碱式只用来量取 20.00 mL 待: The two burettes have different jobs: the acid burette holds HCl (glass stopcock); the base burette only measures out the 20.00 mL sample.
锥形瓶下垫白纸，是为了把「粉红刚好变无色」这一瞬间看清楚。: The white paper under the flask makes the moment when pink just turns colorless easy to see.
待测液的体积 20.00 mL 由滴定管量准，所以锥形瓶不必干燥，也不能用待测液: The 20.00 mL sample volume is measured accurately by the burette, so the flask need not be dry and must not be rinsed with the sample.
去掉这个认识过程：学生会把滴定管当量筒用，读数一错，浓度就全错。: Skip this introduction and students may use the burette like a measuring cylinder; one wrong reading ruins the concentration.
常考器材辨识：酸式与碱式滴定管各能装什么、滴定管为什么比量筒精确。: Common exam item: what acid and base burettes can hold, and why a burette is more precise than a measuring cylinder.
用已知浓度的 HCl 滴定未知浓度的 NaOH：滴定管准确放液、锥形瓶里加指示剂: Titrate NaOH of unknown concentration with HCl of known concentration: the burette delivers liquid accurately, the flask holds the indicator, the indicator's color change marks the endpoint, and the acid used gives c(NaOH).
同样一管 0.1000 mol/L 的盐酸，没润洗会怎样？: Same burette of 0.1000 mol/L HCl. What happens if it is not rinsed?
把「润洗」拨到已用 HCl 润洗 2~3 次，看算出的浓度怎么回落: Set "rinse" to rinsed with HCl 2–3 times and watch the calculated concentration fall back
未润洗时管内残留水把 HCl 稀释到 0.09804 mol/L，要到 21.4: Unrinsed, leftover water dilutes the HCl to 0.09804 mol/L, so the endpoint needs 21.46 mL and c(NaOH) comes out 0.1073 (0.0021 too high); after rinsing it returns to 21.04 mL / 0.1052
润洗 2~3 次 · 每次 3~5 mL · 尖嘴气泡要赶出: Rinse 2–3 times · 3–5 mL each · clear bubbles from the tip
润洗用的是**所要盛装的溶液**，不是蒸馏水——用水润洗等于把标准液稀释。: Rinse with **the solution it will hold**, not distilled water; rinsing with water dilutes the standard solution.
先检查活塞漏不漏水，再润洗、再加液；液面先到「0」刻度以上 2~3 mL 处，再: First check that the stopcock does not leak, then rinse, then fill; bring the level 2–3 mL above "0", then adjust it to the 0 mark.
尖嘴里的气泡必须赶出，不赶的话读数差会比实际放出的体积大。: Bubbles in the tip must be cleared; otherwise the reading difference is larger than the volume actually delivered.
去掉这一步：浓度算出来偏高 0.0021 mol/L，比一次读错刻度还严重。: Skip this step and the concentration comes out 0.0021 mol/L too high, worse than misreading the scale once.
高频考点：为什么要润洗 2~3 次、不润洗结果偏高还是偏低——答的是「标准液被稀: Frequent exam point: why rinse 2–3 times, and whether skipping it makes the result high or low. The answer: the standard solution is diluted, so more must be added.
滴定管必须用所要盛装的 HCl 润洗 2~3 次、赶出尖嘴气泡，再把液面调到「0: The burette must be rinsed 2–3 times with the HCl it will hold, the tip bubble cleared, and the level set to "0" with the reading recorded accurately; otherwise the standard concentration or the reading difference is off.
取液与加指示剂: Taking the sample and adding indicator
待测液为什么是红色、而换成甲基橙却是黄色？: Why is the sample red, but yellow with methyl orange instead?
把指示剂从甲基橙换成酚酞，看锥形瓶里的颜色和终点颜色怎么变: Switch the indicator from methyl orange to phenolphthalein and see how the flask color and the endpoint color change
甲基橙在待测碱里呈黄色；换成酚酞后溶液呈红色（教材原话「这时溶液呈红色」）。两者: Methyl orange is yellow in the basic sample; with phenolphthalein the solution is red (the textbook says "the solution is now red"). The endpoint volumes differ by only 0.017 mL, so either can be used
HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻（酸色 / 碱色）: HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻ (acid color / base color)
20.00 mL 待测 NaOH · 2 滴指示剂: 20.00 mL NaOH sample · 2 drops of indicator
待测液的体积 20.00 mL 由碱式滴定管量取，不是用量筒估的。: The 20.00 mL sample is measured with the base burette, not estimated with a measuring cylinder.
指示剂只加 2 滴：多加会多消耗一点酸，也会让颜色过深、终点难判。: Add only 2 drops of indicator: more uses a little extra acid and makes the color too deep to judge the endpoint.
两个变色范围都要记：酚酞 8.2–10.0、甲基橙 3.1–4.4，都落在突跃里: Remember both ranges: phenolphthalein 8.2–10.0 and methyl orange 3.1–4.4, both inside the jump.
去掉这一步：没有指示剂，pH 突跃再明显也看不见终点。: Skip this step: without an indicator, however sharp the pH jump, the endpoint is invisible.
指示剂变色范围必背；「强酸强碱滴定为什么两种指示剂都能用」要能说成「变色点落在突: Memorize the indicator ranges, and explain "why both indicators work for strong acid–strong base titration" as "the color change falls inside the jump".
指示剂按教材选酚酞：它的变色范围 8.2–10.0 落在突跃内，由粉红变无色就表: Following the textbook, the indicator is phenolphthalein: its range 8.2–10.0 lies inside the jump, and pink turning colorless shows the reaction is complete; methyl orange 3.1–4.4 is also inside the jump, so either can mark the endpoint.
已经加了 20.90 mL，pH 怎么才降了 2.5？: Already 20.90 mL added. Why has the pH dropped only 2.5?
把 HCl 从 0.00 mL 滴到 20.90 mL，盯住 pH 和滴定管末读: Add HCl from 0.00 mL to 20.90 mL, watching the pH and the burette final reading
加了 20.90 mL，pH 才从 13.02 降到 10.53；滴定管末读数: After 20.90 mL the pH has only fallen from 13.02 to 10.53; burette final reading 20.90 mL, calculated c 0.1045; the phenolphthalein is still pink
0.1000 mol/L HCl 逐滴加入 · 边滴边摇动锥形瓶: 0.1000 mol/L HCl added drop by drop · swirl the flask while adding
前 20 mL 里 pH 只挪了两个多单位，靠眼睛分辨不出来。: Over the first 20 mL the pH moves only a little over two units, too little to see by eye.
末读数必须读到 0.01 mL，因为最后差的就是半滴。: The final reading must be to 0.01 mL, because the last difference is just half a drop.
边滴边摇动锥形瓶，否则局部过量，颜色会提前变。: Swirl the flask while adding, or a local excess will change the color too early.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「滴到 pH 7 就停」，而 pH 其实是一瞬间跳过去的。: Skip this step and students may think "stop at pH 7", when the pH actually leaps past it in an instant.
常考「为什么接近终点 pH 会突变」，答的是浓度效应与计量点，不是「酸变强了」。: A common question: why the pH jumps near the endpoint. The answer is a concentration effect and the equivalence point, not "the acid got stronger".
开始时被中和的碱浓度大，加入少量酸对 pH 的影响不大（教材原话），所以只能靠指: At first the base being neutralized is concentrated, so a little acid barely affects the pH (textbook wording). That is why we rely on the indicator's sudden change at the endpoint instead of watching the pH creep to 7.
半滴到终点: Half a drop to the endpoint
最后这半滴到底改变了什么？: What exactly does this last half drop change?
粗滴先停在 21.00 mL（pH 9.99），再把「半滴微调」拧到 +0.04: Coarse-add to 21.00 mL (pH 9.99), then turn "half-drop fine-tune" to +0.04 and watch how the pH jumps and the color changes
粗滴到 21.00 mL 时 pH 9.99，半滴微调到 +0.04（合计 21: At 21.00 mL the pH is 9.99; after fine-tuning +0.04 (21.04 mL total) it falls to 7.00. The half drop from 21.03 to 21.05 crosses 4.77 pH units; phenolphthalein just turns from pink to colorless; jump 4.30–9.70
V(HCl) = 21.04 mL 到达等当点: V(HCl) = 21.04 mL reaches the equivalence point
突跃 4.30–9.70（等当点前后各 0.1 % 的体积）: Jump 4.30–9.70 (volumes within 0.1 % either side of equivalence)
半分钟不变色: No change for half a minute
突跃不是「反应变慢了」，是溶液里 H⁺ 与 OH⁻ 谁过量在一瞬间对调。: The jump is not "the reaction slowing down"; it is the instant when the excess flips between H⁺ and OH⁻.
酚酞由粉红变无色就停；再滴下去只会让 V 偏大、c 偏高。: Stop when phenolphthalein goes from pink to colorless; adding more only makes V too large and c too high.
判终点要「半分钟内不变色」，因为空气中的 CO₂ 也会慢慢让颜色褪。: The endpoint must hold "no color change for half a minute", because CO₂ from the air can slowly fade the color too.
去掉这一步：学生会把终点当成等当点，忽略指示剂变色点与 pH 7 之间那一点差。: Skip this step and students may confuse the endpoint with the equivalence point, ignoring the small gap between the indicator's change and pH 7.
半滴的差别、终点与等当点的区别、为什么不看 pH 到 7 就停，三问常一起考。: The half-drop difference, endpoint versus equivalence point, and why we do not stop at pH 7: these three are often tested together.
接近终点时极少量酸就引起 pH 突变，指示剂颜色突变表示反应已完全（教材原话）；: Near the endpoint a tiny amount of acid causes a pH jump, and the indicator's sudden color change shows the reaction is complete (textbook wording). Within half a drop (0.02 mL) the pH crosses phenolphthalein's whole range, so the endpoint is "pink just turns colorless and stays so for half a minute".
A4.3、A4.9、A3.2、B2.1 算子 8 + D2: A4.3, A4.9, A3.2, B2.1 · operator 8 + D2
21.04 mL 这个数怎么变成浓度？: How does 21.04 mL become a concentration?
点一下滴定管，把末读数读出来: Click the burette to read the final reading
Initial reading 0.00 mL, final reading 21.04 mL, so V(HCl) = 21.04 mL; c(NaOH) = 0.1000 × 21.04 ÷ 20.00 = 0.1052 mol/L
V(HCl) 是末读数减初读数；本课把初读数调到 0.00，但这一步仍要写出来。: V(HCl) is the final reading minus the initial one; this lesson sets the initial reading to 0.00, but you still write it out.
分母是量取的 20.00 mL，不是锥形瓶里混合后的总体积。: The denominator is the 20.00 mL measured out, not the total mixed volume in the flask.
三次滴定取平均值，误差明显偏大的数据要重做（教材方法导引）。: Average three titrations; redo any run with an obviously large error (textbook method guide).
去掉这一步：知道用了多少却算不出多浓，滴定就白做了。: Skip this step and you know how much was used but not how concentrated it was, so the titration is wasted.
计算式与代入是必考：V 指滴定管读数差、分母是待测液体积，两者别混。: The formula and substitution are always tested: V is the burette reading difference and the denominator is the sample volume; do not mix them up.
由 1 : 1 的计量关系算出待测浓度；教材例题用同一个算式把 27.84 mL: The 1 : 1 stoichiometry gives the sample concentration; the textbook example puts 27.84 mL and 25.00 mL into the same formula to get 0.1149 mol/L.
箱子里最后一个 OH⁻ 是被谁带走的？: Who takes away the last OH⁻ in the box?
点一下台面上方那个放大箱，看里面的离子怎么结合: Click the magnified box above the bench and see how the ions combine
起点箱里 105 个 OH⁻、没有 H⁺；滴到等当点时最后一个 OH⁻ 与刚进来: At the start the box has 105 OH⁻ and no H⁺; at the equivalence point the last OH⁻ combines with an incoming H⁺ into H₂O, leaving neither; further drops leave only H⁺ (magnified for illustration, viewing the flask)
示意放大 · 1 个粒子 = 0.02 mmol · 正在看：锥形瓶: Magnified for illustration · 1 particle = 0.02 mmol · viewing: flask
每滴入 1 个 H⁺ 就消耗 1 个 OH⁻，所以计量关系是「物质的量 1 :: Each H⁺ added uses up one OH⁻, so the stoichiometry is "1 : 1 in amount of substance", not "equal concentrations".
等当点两侧不会同时剩下 H⁺ 和 OH⁻，因为中和几乎进行到底。: H⁺ and OH⁻ are never both left over on either side of equivalence, because neutralization goes almost to completion.
指示剂变色的原因也是离子数目的相对变化（教材资料卡片的解释）。: The indicator changes color because of the relative change in ion numbers too (as the textbook's information card explains).
去掉这一步：学生只会背「半滴变色」，说不出半滴为什么足够。: Skip this step and students only memorize "half a drop changes the color" without being able to say why half a drop is enough.
微观解释题：为什么是 1 : 1、为什么恰好完全反应时呈中性、指示剂为什么在突跃: Microscopic explanation questions: why 1 : 1, why the solution is neutral at exact neutralization, and why the indicator changes inside the jump.
滴定的实质是 H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O：等当点 n(H⁺) = n(OH⁻): The essence of titration is H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O: at equivalence n(H⁺) = n(OH⁻) and the solution is neutral (pH 7.00); the indicator changes because the pH crosses its range at that instant.
四个「小疏忽」，各让结果偏哪边？: Four small slips: which way does each push the result?
把「润洗」关掉（错误操作），看算出的浓度怎么变；再把气泡、读数方式（三档）、锥形: Turn "rinse" off (a mistake) and watch the calculated concentration change; then toggle bubbles, reading method (three settings) and flask one by one
四个开关逐个拨，各偏一边：未润洗 → 读数 21.46 mL（偏大 0.42）→: Toggle the four switches one at a time; each pushes one way: unrinsed → reading 21.46 mL (0.42 too large) → c 0.1073 (0.0021 high); tip bubble → 0.1055 (high); look up before · down after → 0.1047 (low); look down before · up after → 0.1057 (high); flask rinsed with sample → 0.1068 (high)
每次只弄错一处，其余保持正确: Make only one mistake at a time; keep the rest correct
润洗不到位 → HCl 被稀释 → 要多滴才到终点 → 读数差偏大 → c 偏高: Poor rinsing → HCl diluted → more needed to reach the endpoint → reading difference too large → c too high.
尖嘴气泡在滴定中消失 → 读数差大于实际放出的体积 → c 偏高。: Tip bubble disappears during titration → reading difference larger than the volume delivered → c too high.
滴前仰视、滴后俯视 → 读数差偏小 → c 偏低 0.1047；反过来滴前俯视、: Looking up before and down after → reading difference too small → c too low (0.1047); looking down before and up after → difference too large → c too high (0.1057); flask rinsed with sample → more base in the flask → c too high.
去掉这一步：学生把「偏高偏低」当口诀背，遇到两个错误同时出现就判断不出来。: Skip this step and students memorize "high or low" as a rhyme, then cannot judge when two mistakes happen together.
误差方向几乎每年考：要把「改变了哪个量 → 读数差变大还是变小 → c 偏哪边」: Error direction is tested almost every year: write out "which quantity changed → reading difference larger or smaller → which way c goes".
每个错误都是先改变一个量、再把偏差传到 c：润洗不到位（0.1073）、尖嘴气泡: Each mistake first changes one quantity, then passes the error to c: poor rinsing (0.1073), tip bubble (0.1055), flask rinsed with sample (0.1068), and looking down before + up after (0.1057) all make the reading difference or the amount of sample too large → c too high; looking up before + down after (0.1047) makes the reading difference too small → c too low.

只能用酚酞，甲基橙变色太早: Only phenolphthalein works; methyl orange changes too early
酚酞与甲基橙都能用，因为变色范围都落在突跃内: Both phenolphthalein and methyl orange work, since both ranges lie inside the jump
只能用甲基橙，酚酞在碱性溶液里不变色: Only methyl orange works; phenolphthalein does not change in basic solution
强酸强碱滴定不需要指示剂: A strong acid–strong base titration needs no indicator
突跃 4.30–9.70，酚酞 8.2–10.0 与甲基橙 3.1–4.4 都落: The jump is 4.30–9.70, and both phenolphthalein 8.2–10.0 and methyl orange 3.1–4.4 fall inside it; their endpoint volumes differ by only 0.017 mL. The textbook specifies phenolphthalein for this lab.
滴定前，酸式滴定管与锥形瓶的处理正确的是: Before titration, the correct treatment of the acid burette and the flask is
两支都用蒸馏水润洗 2~3 次: Rinse both with distilled water 2–3 times
滴定管用所要盛装的 HCl 润洗 2~3 次，锥形瓶不润洗、不必干燥: Rinse the burette 2–3 times with the HCl it will hold; do not rinse the flask, and it need not be dry
滴定管与锥形瓶都用待测 NaOH 润洗: Rinse both the burette and the flask with the NaOH sample
锥形瓶必须烘干到完全无水: The flask must be oven-dried completely
滴定管要用所要盛装的溶液润洗，否则标准液被稀释；锥形瓶里待测液的量已由滴定管量准: The burette must be rinsed with the solution it will hold, or the standard is diluted; the amount of sample in the flask is already measured by the burette, so rinsing the flask adds base and makes the result high.
滴定管的「0」刻度在上。若滴定前仰视读数、滴定后俯视读数，则读出的体积与真实值相: The burette's "0" mark is at the top. If you look up when reading before titration and look down when reading after, compared with the true volume the reading is
滴定管刻度自上而下增大：仰视使读数偏大、俯视使读数偏小，两者相减的读数差偏小，算: Burette marks increase downward: looking up gives a larger reading, looking down a smaller one, so the difference is too small and the calculated c is too low.
用酚酞作指示剂时，判断到达滴定终点的正确现象是: With phenolphthalein as indicator, the correct sign of the endpoint is
溶液由粉红色刚好变为无色，且半分钟内不变色: The solution just turns from pink to colorless and stays so for half a minute
溶液一出现浅粉红就立即停止: Stop as soon as a faint pink appears
滴入最后一滴后颜色明显变深: The color deepens clearly after the last drop
教材原话：因加入半滴酸后，溶液颜色从粉红色刚好变为无色，且半分钟内不变色。pH: Textbook wording: after half a drop of acid, the solution just turns from pink to colorless and does not change for half a minute. pH 7.00 is the equivalence point, which is not the same as the endpoint.
酸式滴定管未用 HCl 润洗就开始滴定，其他操作都正确，则测得的 c(NaOH): If the acid burette is not rinsed with HCl before titrating and everything else is correct, the measured c(NaOH) is
管内残留水把 HCl 稀释（0.09804 mol/L），要多滴到 21.46: Leftover water dilutes the HCl (0.09804 mol/L), so it takes 21.46 mL to reach the endpoint; the reading difference is too large and c rises from 0.1052 to 0.1073: too high.
某次滴定初读数 0.00 mL、末读数 21.04 mL，待测 NaOH 取 2: In one titration the initial reading is 0.00 mL and the final 21.04 mL, with 20.00 mL NaOH sample and 0.1000 mol/L HCl. c(NaOH) is
换成酚酞：待测碱里呈红色，终点由粉红变无色: Switched to phenolphthalein: red in the basic sample; endpoint pink → colorless
换成甲基橙：待测碱里呈黄色，终点由黄变橙: Switched to methyl orange: yellow in the basic sample; endpoint yellow → orange
已用 HCl 润洗 2~3 次：标准液浓度不再被残留水稀释: Rinsed 2–3 times with HCl: leftover water no longer dilutes the standard
未润洗：管内残留水把 HCl 稀释到 0.09804 mol/L，算出的 c 偏: Not rinsed: leftover water dilutes HCl to 0.09804 mol/L, so the calculated c is too high
尖嘴气泡已赶出：读数差 = 实际放出的体积: Tip bubble cleared: reading difference = volume actually delivered
尖嘴有气泡：气泡消失后读数差大于实际放出的体积，c 偏高: Bubble in the tip: once it vanishes the reading difference exceeds the volume delivered, so c is too high
平视凹液面最低处：读数准确: Eye level with the bottom of the meniscus: accurate reading
滴前仰视、滴后俯视：读数差偏小 0.10 mL，算出的 c 偏低: Looking up before, down after: difference 0.10 mL too small, calculated c too low
滴前俯视、滴后仰视：读数差偏大 0.10 mL，算出的 c 偏高: Looking down before, up after: difference 0.10 mL too large, calculated c too high
锥形瓶干燥、未润洗：瓶里只有量好的 20.00 mL 待测液: Flask dry, not rinsed: it holds only the measured 20.00 mL sample
锥形瓶用待测液润洗过：瓶壁多出碱，算出的 c 偏高: Flask rinsed with sample: extra base on the walls, calculated c too high
异常：读数方式被拨成「滴前仰视 · 滴后俯视」——c 掉到 0.1047，先改回: Fault: reading method switched to "look up before · down after"; c dropped to 0.1047, switch back to eye level first
